_doc: Curated {p_bull, p_base} catalyst splits (our view). p_bear = 1 - p_bull - p_base. Scenario FVs (bear/base/bull) are pulled from the band-watch baskets where present, else set here. p_favorable in catalyst_predictions is NOT p_bull (it conflates bull+lean) — set the explicit 3-way split here. Names with FVs but no split show market-implied p_bull for reference (NO_VIEW).
